mapper.sql: t.* , version.version_no AS version_no , scenario.code AS scenario_code , scenario.name AS scenario_name
FROM aps_task t LEFT JOIN aps_version version ON version.id = t.version_id AND version.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN aps_scenario scenario ON scenario.id = version.scenario_id AND scenario.deleted = 0
mapper.select:
SELECT
ORDER BY t.res_id ASC, t.start_time ASC

SELECT t.prod_order_id AS prod_order_id , MIN(t.prod_order_no) AS prod_order_no , COUNT(1) AS task_count , COALESCE(SUM(t.duration_minutes), 0) AS load_minutes , MIN(t.start_time) AS plan_start_time , MAX(t.end_time) AS plan_end_time , MIN(po.mat_id) AS mat_id , MIN(po.mat_code) AS mat_code , MIN(po.due_date) AS due_date FROM aps_task t LEFT JOIN aps_version version ON version.id = t.version_id AND version.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT scenario_id, prod_order_id, MIN(mat_id) AS mat_id, MIN(mat_code) AS mat_code , MIN(due_date) AS due_date FROM aps_projection_order WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY scenario_id, prod_order_id ) po ON po.scenario_id = version.scenario_id AND po.prod_order_id = t.prod_order_id WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.version_id = #{versionId} GROUP BY t.prod_order_id
ORDER BY CASE WHEN MIN(po.due_date) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC , MIN(po.due_date) ASC, MIN(t.start_time) ASC
